reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Refill Set (+Refill 360ml)
reviews.text: This is a repurchase for me so can’t say any more good things hahha! It is nice and unless your hair is super dry or you want additional moisture, this shampoo alone is moisturising enough on its own.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我再買，所以冇咩更多好嘢可以講，哈哈！幾好用，除非你嘅頭髮好乾，或者你想要額外保濕，否則呢支洗頭水單獨用已經保濕足夠。

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Refill Set (+Refill 360ml)
reviews.text: After using this shampoo, my hair feels dirty even right after washing, as if nothing was actually cleansed. No matter how thoroughly I rinse with water, I’m left with a strange residue-like sensation. When I run my fingers through my hair, especially near the roots, it feels greasy and unclean. Very disappointed, as I bought with refill 😩will not be buying again.
reviews.zh: 用咗呢支洗髮水之後，頭髮洗完即刻已經感覺唔乾淨，好似咩都冇真正洗走咁。無論用水沖幾徹底，都仲係有種好奇怪嘅殘留感。手指撈過頭髮，尤其係近頭皮嗰度，會覺得油膩、唔潔淨。好失望，我係連補充裝一齊買嘅 😩 唔會再買。

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: This is without question the most utterly delicious-smelling shampoo I have ever used. It smells like the most perfect cup of refreshing jasmine tea and if I could get body products to match, I would be basting myself like a chicken.
reviews.zh: 呢支絕對係我用過最好聞嘅洗髮水，冇得比。味道好似一杯清新嘅茉莉花茶咁完美；如果搵到配套嘅身體產品，我真係會將自己塗滿，好似隻焗雞咁。

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Refill Set (+Refill 360ml)
reviews.text: I love this shampoo! I definitely feel a difference in volume after every wash. And I love the subtle scent too - not too strong as I’m sensitive to smell. My teen daughter loves it too !
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支洗髮水！每次洗完頭，都明顯感覺到頭髮蓬鬆咗。我都好鍾意佢嘅淡淡香味，唔會太濃，因為我對氣味好敏感。我十幾歲嘅女兒都好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: I had a sample of this shampoo and loved it! It made my hair feel silky and look healthy. I now take less time to straighten my hair because of it. The scent is familiar to me so I'm not bothered by it. However, if you're sensitive to "strong" (floral) scents, I would not recommend. I would buy this again!
reviews.zh: 我之前試過呢支洗髮水嘅試用裝，非常鍾意！用完之後頭髮變得柔滑，睇落都健康。因為用咗佢，我而家拉直頭髮嘅時間短咗。我對個味道幾熟悉，所以唔介意。不過，如果你對「濃烈」（花香）嘅味道敏感，我就唔會推薦。我會再買！

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: Perfectly cleans my hair and scalp without stripping or making my hair knotted, which a lot of shampoos do to me. I truly love everything by this manufacturer - this line of products has absolutely rejuvenated my hair after a perm destroyed it two years ago. Two weeks with these products and my hair is back to how it was before.
reviews.zh: 洗得好乾淨，唔會好似好多洗髮水咁，令我嘅頭髮乾身、打結。我真係好鍾意呢個品牌嘅所有產品。兩年前燙過頭，頭髮受損得好嚴重，用咗呢個系列之後，頭髮真係重新煥發生機。用咗兩個星期，頭髮就返返回之前嘅狀態。

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: I’m trying to give this shampoo another shot because i think it made my hair a bit oily so i think it is more suitable for dry hair and scalp. Will continue using it to know how i feel about it and resubmit another response if there would be any. But in fairness it softened my hair
reviews.zh: 我想再俾呢支洗髮水一次機會，因為我覺得佢令我頭髮有啲油，所以我諗佢可能更適合乾性頭髮同頭皮。我會繼續用，睇吓自己感覺點，如果有新嘅感受會再回覆。不過公道啲講，佢令頭髮軟咗。

reviews.shade: Treecell Day Collagen Shampoo #Morning of Resort Set (360ml+120ml)
reviews.text: Lovely smell, hair felt softer when wet but scalp feels itchy later in the day and hair dried feeling rough. Have only used once so far, will keep using and update if improvements seen
reviews.zh: 味道好好聞，頭髮濕嗰陣覺得軟啲，但係到咗日頭，頭皮會有啲痕癢，頭髮乾咗之後覺得粗糙。我到而家只用過一次，會繼續用，如果見到改善會再更新。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
